mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the 3-month Treasury yield indicates a tightening monetary policy cycle, which raises discount rates and compresses the present value of future equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the 3-month Treasury yield signals a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of future equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
